bots.name: Welcomer
bots.description: Welcomer says hello to each person who joins, in the channel you pick, so nobody arrives to silence. Write the greeting yourself and drop in their name, the community's name or how many people are here now.
bots.sample: Hey @ana, welcome to Night Owls! You're member number 42. 🎉

limits.plus: Up to 10, one picked at random

bots.name: Helper
bots.description: Helper keeps a few party tricks ready in every channel it can post in: dice, a coin, a fortune ball and a picker for when nobody can decide. People can leave an away note too, and Helper answers for them while they're gone. Nothing to set up.

commands.description: A yes-or-no question for the fortune ball
Roll dice (a d6 unless you say otherwise)
Leave an away note until you're back
Every command the bots here know

bots.name: Levels
bots.tagline: XP for chatting, levels for regulars
bots.description: Levels hands out a little XP when people chat (once a minute at most, so spamming gets nowhere) and cheers when someone goes up a level. !rank shows where you stand and !top the ten most active. Its leaderboard can go on your lobby too.

bots.name: Logger
bots.tagline: A quiet record of what changed
bots.description: Logger writes one short line into the channel you choose for every edit, deletion, join, leave, kick, ban, timeout and role change, and never pings anyone. It stays quiet until you pick its channel: a private one is best, so only your team reads it.
bots.sample: ✏️ Ana edited a message in #general: “see you at 8” → “see you at 9”

limits.what: Member events in their own channel

bots.name: Starboard
bots.tagline: The best messages, picked by everyone
bots.description: When enough people react to a message with ⭐ or 🌟, Starboard copies it to your starboard channel with a link back and keeps its star count up to date. Your own stars don't count, private channels are skipped, and no message goes up twice.
bots.sample:
⭐ 6 · Ana in #memes
this is the one

bots.name: Giveaways
bots.description: Giveaways runs a prize draw from a single message. Anyone who manages messages in a channel can start one there: people react 🎉 to enter, and when time's up the bot draws the winners from people still in the community and calls them out. Bots never win, and running draws show on your lobby.
bots.sample:
🎉 Giveaway: a game key
React with 🎉 to enter · 1 winner · ends in 1 day · hosted by Ana

commands.description: Start a draw here (s, m, h, d or w)
Three winners, drawn in two hours
Draw someone else for the last one

limits.what: Only members with a role can win

bots.name: Tickets
bots.tagline: Private help desks for your members
bots.description: Tickets posts a panel with an "Open a ticket" button. Each ticket is a private channel between the person who opened it and your moderators, and either side closes it once it's sorted. Turning Tickets on here is the same switch as Settings › Tickets.

limits.what: A support role that sees tickets and is pinged
Welcome line in each new ticket
Transcript in the log when closed

bots.name: Alerts
bots.description: Alerts follows the YouTube channels you add and posts each new upload in the channel you pick, with a ping for a role if you like. It looks every ten minutes and only ever posts videos that came out after you added the channel.
bots.sample:
📣 Ana just posted a new video: Speedrun night recap
https://youtu.be/…
bots.unavailableReason: Needs a YouTube API key on this server

bots.name: Wordy
bots.description: Wordy picks the same five-letter word for everyone here each day (new at 00:00 UTC). You get six tries, the board shows colours but never letters, and Wordy keeps streaks, the best solvers and a recap of yesterday in its channel.

commands.description: Start or show your game of the day
Guess (or just type a five-letter word in Wordy's channel)
Your streak and the best solvers here

botsPlus.name: Bots+
botsPlus.description: Every official bot's Plus extras, for this whole community.
perks: Up to 10 greetings and a goodbye
Bigger, longer giveaways for a role
10 ticket panels with support roles and transcripts
